## Overview

This assignment uses a publicly available data set containing inpatient discharge
counts for facilities across the state of Florida during 2024. The purpose of this
analysis is to load the data into R, perform basic transformations, and create a
clean data frame suitable for further analysis.
library(readxl)

inpatient_data <- read_excel("2024 INPATIENT & COMP DATA.xlsx")

str(inpatient_data)
head(inpatient_data)

inpatient_subset <- inpatient_data[, c(
  "FACILITY COUNTY",
  "FACILITY CITY",
  "FACILITY NAME",
  "QTR 1",
  "QTR 2",
  "QTR 3",
  "QTR 4"
)]

summary(inpatient_subset)

## Conclusions

Preliminary inspection of the data suggests that inpatient discharge volumes
vary substantially across Florida regions. Facilities in Central and Northern
Florida appear to report higher inpatient counts compared to those in South
Florida, indicating potential regional differences in healthcare utilization.
